desc: Th Condition One Top Optical Plate allows a user to direct mount an optic driectly to the 12 O'Clock postion on a standard C1 mount. The Top Optical Plate replaces either your front or back Condition One ringcap on any 30mm or 34mm C1 mount. Made from 7075 T6 Aluminum Type III Hardcoat anodized Black or Tan. Not compatible with C1 MAX Mounts.
